      technology services, after careful research and discussion, the Group has decided                  合性，經審慎研究及討論，本集團決定將主營業務

FUTURE OUTLOOK: DEEPENING REFORMS,                                         未來展望：深化改革，聚焦價值
FOCUSING ON VALUE
This may be a challenging period for the industry as homogeneity           可能到了行業面對挑戰的時段 — 行業同質化
intensifies, demand differentiation diverges, boundaries blur and          加 劇，需 求 差 異 化 加 劇，邊 界 在 模 糊，焦 慮

industry is still in a period of growth and opportunity. When the noise    — 行業仍處於發展的上升期、機遇期，當喧
fades and the froth clears, those who truly understand service product     囂 褪 去、浮 沫 散 盡，真 正 懂 服 務 產 品 設 計 與
design and iteration, and the enterprises that consistently contribute     迭代的人，持續為市場需求貢獻願力與創意
their dedication and creativity to meeting market demand, will             的企業，終將被看見、被需要。
ultimately be seen and needed.

The year of 2026 marks a pivotal year for Greentown Service to             2026 年，是 綠 城 服 務 從「改 革」走 向「全 面 深
transition from “reform” to “comprehensive deepening of reform”,           化改革」的關鍵之年，是從提升價值到重塑價
and leap from enhancing value to reshaping value. We will continue         值的跨越之年。我們將繼續保持戰略定力，
to maintain strategic focus, placing projects at the core, products as     以 項 目 為 王、產 品 為 核、團 隊 為 本，以 長 期
the foundation and teams as the bedrock. We will adopt long-termism        主義對沖短期波動與認知，用確定的服務價
to hedge against short-term volatility and cognition, and respond to       值去應對不確定的外部環境。服務是一場沒
an uncertain external environment with the certainty of service value.     有 終 點 的 長 跑，深 耕 者 自 有 正 反 饋，有 恆 心

FOREIGN EXCHANGE RISKS                                                     外匯風險
The Group conducts substantially all of its businesses in China, with      本集團主要集中於中國經營業務，絕大部分
most of the transactions conducted in Renminbi. Therefore, the Group       業務以人民幣進行。因而承受的外匯風險有
is exposed to limited foreign currency exchange rate risk. During          限。年 內，本 集 團 未 使 用 任 何 金 融 工 具 作 對
the year, the Group has not employed any financial instruments for         沖用途，也未訂立任何遠期外匯買賣合同以
hedging purposes or engaged in any forward foreign exchange                作外匯風險對沖用途。本集團將堅持密切監
contracts for foreign exchange risk hedging purposes. The Group will       察所涉及的匯率風險及利率風險，積極與各
continue to closely monitor its exposure to exchange rate and interest     大銀行探討外匯對沖方案，於有需要時利用
rate risks and actively explore foreign exchange hedging options with      衍生金融工具對沖所涉及的風險。
major banks, and may employ derivative financial instruments to hedge
against risks when necessary.

     the Group’s existing businesses and proposed new business to be
     developed.

     investment strategy, focusing on the Group’s main businesses,                 收購的標的公司的經營效益管理，加快虧損

RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL                                        風險管理及內部控制
The Board acknowledges its responsibility to ensure that sound risk         董事會確認其有責任確保在本集團內建立和
management (including environmental, social and governance risk) and        維持完善的風險管理（包括環境、社會及管治

absolute, assurance against material misstatement, loss or fraud.
